name: WanGP
description: A fast AI Video Generator for the GPU Poor. Supports Minimax H3, LTX-2.3/2.5, Wan 2.1/2.2,  Qwen Image 1/2, Krea 2, Hunyuan Video, LTX  Video and Flux.
readme: WanGP by DeepBeepMeep : The best Open Source Generative Models Accessible to the GPU Poor WanGP is a one-stop super app for open source generative models: create videos, images, music, speech and 3D assets, then step inside interactive worlds. Run locally on your own GPU, use the browser interface, or let Deepy Prime turn your ideas into finished creations.
